scope: Cell pellets thawed on ice and NP-40 lysis buffer (ThermoFisher, cat # FNN0021) with 1X mammalian cell protease inhibitor cocktail (Sigma Aldrich, cat # P8340) was added to pellets at 5X volume.
Cells were resuspended in lysis buffer by pipetting up and down ten times, then incubated with inverted rocking for 1 h at 4 °C.

Samples were centrifuged at 13,000 RPM at 4 °C for 15 min. Supernatants were transferred to new Eppendorf tubes and the protein concentration of respective lysates were determined with BCA (ThermoFisher, cat # 23252).
